reasoning: The adversary escalated privileges from www-data to user jhall and executed sudo to read /etc/shadow, confirming credential access.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the affected host intranet-server (10.143.2.4) from the network to prevent lateral movement. 2. Terminate all active sessions and processes for user jhall and the web service account. 3. Rotate credentials for root, jhall, and all accounts listed in /etc/shadow. 4. Inspect the web directory /var/www/.../wp-content/uploads/ for malicious webshells and remove unauthorized files. 5. Review and restrict sudo permissions in /etc/sudoers for non-administrative accounts.
